NBA DFS Picks for Monday, November 2 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, November 2 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 2, 8:11 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Monday, November 2 DraftKings main slate at 55.1 DraftKings points for $11,100. Cooper Flagg (DAL, 51.8, $9,600) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.8, $10,100) are next.

Braden Smith (IND) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 10.61 projected points per $1,000 at $3,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 2, 8:11 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
